Package
Description
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.peering.enums
Classification enums for Peering Intelligence: ConnectivityType (how an ASN is reachable at a metro — IX, Fabric, both, facility-only, none), PeeringPolicy and NetworkType (parsed from PeeringDB's policy_general / info_type fields), DiversityRating (distance-banded geographic diversity, with UNKNOWN reserved for unavailable distances), and FailureScope (blast-radius failure domains).
